item.title: Majority of South Africans embrace AI for holiday planning, Kaspersky survey reveals
item.description: In a time when the holiday spirit is complemented by technology, South Africans are turning to AI for help and companionship. Kaspersky’s recent survey reveals vast enthusiasm for AI tools, but underscores the importance of remaining vigilant against potential cyber threats. Embrace festivities while protecting your personal space this holiday season!
